problems.title: Current Navigation separates the task collections used by the legacy split
problems.source_location: Current author commit e34bbcee3c48f03833270550151eb6646267fa3b; examples/train/navigation/train_navigation_base_common.yaml and val_navigation_base_common.yaml; vagen/envs/navigation/navigation_env.py, lines 99–105 and 154–170
claim: The legacy example reused one \(60\)-task collection under the seed-to-index rule \(s\bmod60\); separate seed labels could therefore identify the same task. This was previously discussed in author issues 62 and 67.
analysis: The current default branch instead selects base_train/common_sense_train for training and base/common_sense for evaluation. Reading all corresponding JSON task records gives \(1200\) training and \(60\) evaluation tasks per category, with zero identical task records and zero overlapping scene identifiers within either category or across the combined categories. Modulo selection now acts on the separately chosen collections, so it does not establish the old cross-split identity.
result: The legacy overlap mechanism is fixed in these current configurations. No trained-model evaluation or correction of the old reported scores is claimed.
problems.existing_correction_status: The current author implementation supplies distinct scene collections; earlier author discussions documented the legacy concern and planned remediation.
problems.impact_rationale: Current source and complete task-list comparison remove the supplied concrete overlap witness; no present error is established in this scope.

problems.title: Current Sokoban configuration no longer uses the same valid-seed prefix
problems.source_location: Current author commit e34bbcee3c48f03833270550151eb6646267fa3b; examples/train/sokoban/train_sokoban_wm_think.yaml and val_sokoban_wm_think.yaml; vagen/envs/sokoban/patch_sokoban_env.py, lines 12–51 and 119–169
claim: The legacy generator returned \(V[:10000]\) and \(V[:128]\) from one ordered valid list, proving test-prefix inclusion. Author issue 106 had already identified this historical defect.
analysis: The current inspected configurations use training seeds \([1,10000]\) and evaluation seeds \([10001,10256]\), with direct seeded reset rather than the old duplicated-prefix utility. The current reset also has an explicit optional canonical-room hash partition and a deterministic retry rule. Consequently the former common-prefix proof no longer applies. The inspected example leaves the optional room partition at its default; disjoint seed ranges alone do not prove that every generated board is distinct.
result: The supplied prefix defect is absent from the current path. Exhaustive board uniqueness or symmetry separation is not certified, and no new board-overlap result is inferred without generation evidence.
problems.existing_correction_status: The current author source replaces legacy prefix generation and supplies a configurable canonical-room partition; no claim about corrected historical scores follows.
problems.impact_rationale: The original demonstrated mechanism has been removed; the remaining generic possibility of seed collisions is a limitation, not an established current finding.

problems.title: Current FrozenLake constructs the map from the reset seed
problems.source_location: Current author commit e34bbcee3c48f03833270550151eb6646267fa3b; vagen/envs/frozenlake/frozenlake_env.py, lines 91–124
claim: The legacy constructor generated a map from an unspecified seed before reset, so recording reset seed \(s\) did not determine the map \(G(U)\).
analysis: Current reset calls _create_gym_env with the reset seed, whose map-generation call explicitly forwards that seed, then constructs and resets the Gym environment with that description. The relevant order is now \(G(s)\) followed by environment reset. An explicit configured description remains an intentional fixed-map special case. This static source trace removes the former late-seeding mechanism without executing a simulator.
result: The old reset-seed propagation defect is fixed in current source. Cross-worker reproducibility, full service behavior and original experimental maps were not replayed.
problems.existing_correction_status: The author default branch now regenerates the map using the reset seed; the earlier issue 106 concerned the legacy implementation.
problems.impact_rationale: The missing seed argument and construction order have changed directly in the current implementation; the supplied current-error claim is cleared within that scope.
